source_records.central_source_native_mechanism: Stochastic optimal motor control with state-dependent sensory reliability jointly optimizes control and estimation; the affine observation-noise term yields a feedforward component in addition to feedback, allowing the action to change future sensory informativeness.

variable_roles.learned_variables: No experience-trained latent policy is the central mechanism; optimal time-indexed control and estimator gains are solved iteratively from the specified dynamics/cost.
variable_roles.task_world_variables: physical hand/arm state, motor command, movement direction, velocity-dependent cursor visibility and motor/sensory noise
variable_roles.fitted_latent_variables: model/participant parameterization and noise/cost settings are fitted or specified; they are not a learned task-set state
variable_roles.experimental_outcomes: human hand trajectories, directional deviations and model-to-human movement statistics

direct_ancestor_evidence.relationship: The source explicitly states that its alternating optimal-control/estimation algorithm is based on Todorov's stochastic optimal control method.

adverse_limits: The correction changes the Fig9 legend relation but does not establish a new central model.
S1 Text bytes were not independently frozen in W5; profile claims are therefore bounded to central mechanisms available in the main publisher article plus the correction.
A bounded mechanism difference from another paper does not certify global family independence.

source_records.central_source_native_mechanism: A systems motor-learning model combines a basal-ganglia motor loop that learns goal-to-concrete-action associations using novelty-modulated three-factor Hebbian plasticity with a cerebellar reservoir that learns endpoint-error corrections to CPG motor-program parameters.

variable_roles.learned_variables: basal-ganglia goal/action association weights and cerebellar reservoir output corrections/projection weights
variable_roles.task_world_variables: motor goal, concrete action/CPG parameters, joint/hand state, target endpoint and perturbation/environmental act-and-sense outcome
variable_roles.fitted_latent_variables: simulation hyperparameters such as reservoir learning/perturbation settings and noise; these are not behavioral latent contexts
variable_roles.experimental_outcomes: endpoint error, adaptation/generalization and after-effect/performance curves

publisher_source_loci: Materials and methods: feature inference using context-specific successor maps and Bayesian context belief
Materials and methods: sticky-CRP context prior and particle-filter/Bayesian inference
Materials and methods: outcome inference using the existing PFC transfer model from ref.51
Joint feature/outcome inference and FI-only/OI-only/control comparisons
source_records.central_source_native_mechanism: The paper combines two inherited Bayesian contextual-inference systems: feature inference over context-specific successor-feature maps and outcome inference over reward/outcome-linked predictive maps. A joint strategy integrates their context evidence before context-conditioned action-value/TD-guided choice.

variable_roles.learned_variables: context-specific successor-feature maps, outcome/reward predictive maps and context-conditioned TD/action-value representations
variable_roles.task_world_variables: maze location, environmental cues/features, actions, reward/outcome contingencies and transition/task schedule
variable_roles.fitted_latent_variables: latent context z and its Bayesian posterior/belief state; model hyperparameters are tuned separately and then held as described
variable_roles.experimental_outcomes: agent attempts/performance, inferred-context accuracy and representational/splitter-like simulation measures

direct_ancestor_evidence.relationship: The source explicitly says feature inference implements the existing hippocampal probabilistic successor-representation model from ref.24.
The source explicitly says outcome inference uses the existing PFC transfer-learning model from ref.51; the cited Madarasz-Behrens work has this DataCite arXiv DOI.

adverse_limits: The paper integrates inherited FI and OI models; it does not establish that their entire historical model families are identical.
Latent context belief must not be conflated with task/world variables, learned successor maps, or empirical outcome measures.
Alternative/switching variants are not canonicalized by W5.

source_records.central_source_native_mechanism: A compositional Bayesian task-structure learner assigns each context separately to reward-function and mapping/transition-function CRP clusters and binds those components through planning to form a policy. The central comparison is a joint-clustering learner assigning a context to one holistic task cluster; a later meta-agent arbitrates between the two by model evidence.

variable_roles.learned_variables: context-conditioned reward functions, action/mapping or transition functions, cluster sufficient statistics and resulting planned policies
variable_roles.task_world_variables: context, grid state, primitive and cardinal actions, rewards/goals and environmental transition/mapping structure
variable_roles.fitted_latent_variables: independent reward-cluster and mapping-cluster assignments or joint task-cluster assignment; CRP/model-evidence latent structure
variable_roles.experimental_outcomes: simulated steps/performance, transfer/generalization, information gain/model evidence and policy-selection behavior
